Jordan Park: Hi all — quick question for my first PR: how big is too big? I have a refactor + small bugfix that touch ~6 files. Should I split?
Lina Gomez: welcome Jordan! split if there are two distinct intents. refactor separate from bugfix makes reviews simpler.
Ravi Patel: +1. If the refactor is unrelated to the bugfix, do two PRs. reviewers can focus.
Jordan Park: is there an official max-size guideline? like max number of files or lines?
DevEx Bot: devex-bot: reference: CONTRIBUTING.md -> "Prefer PRs under ~300 lines and <10 files when possible". Exceptions allowed with justification.
Lina Gomez: also include a short "what changed" section in the PR body and a couple bullet points about why. helps speed reviews.
Jordan Park: commit message style? we use conventional commits?
Ravi Patel: we like conventional-ish: feat(scope): short summary. chore:, fix:, refactor: etc. Put ticket number in parentheses at end e.g. "fix(cache): handle nil timestamp (RFC-112)".
Jordan Park: branch naming?
Lina Gomez: `dev/<initials>/<short>` or `feature/<ticket>-short`. try to include ticket id for traceability.
CI Bot: ci-bot: Tip: run `make ci-local` to replicate CI steps (lint + unit tests + typecheck). Save time.
Jordan Park: do we squash on merge or keep commits?
Ravi Patel: we usually squash merge for small changes. For multi-commit work with a meaningful history, keep commits and rebase cleanly.
Lina Gomez: and please don't push large autogenerated files (proto codegen, node_modules, dist). If you need generated changes, add a short note why in the PR.
Jordan Park: any reviewers I should tag for infra-related stuff?
Ravi Patel: tag @lina for frontend infra, @ravi for runtime infra. There's a CODEOWNERS file that also auto-assigns core areas.
DevEx Bot: devex-bot: reminder: run `pre-commit run --all-files` and `make lint` before pushing. Failing pre-commit blocks CI.
Jordan Park: what about tests — do you prefer one big integration test or a few small unit tests?
Lina Gomez: mostly unit tests for logic, integration tests for cross-service behavior. keep tests fast. use mocks where appropriate.
Ravi Patel: if CI flakes, include the CI link in the PR and add "flake:investigate" label; someone from eng-sre will triage.
Jordan Park: thanks! last q: staging deploys for PRs?
Lina Gomez: we have ephemeral review apps for small PRs if the change includes UI — mention "review-app: needed" in the PR template. backend-only usually doesn't need it.
Jordan Park: awesome. I'll split refactor out and open a small bugfix PR first. will tag reviewers. thanks all! :smile:
